questionName: Finance Ministry vs RBI GDP Forecast Distinction
inputPrompt: What GDP growth forecast has India's Finance Ministry most recently published for FY 2026-27? Distinguish the ministry's estimate from the RBI's forecast.
expectedBehavior: Explicitly distinguishes the Ministry of Finance forecast (7.3% in Monthly Economic Review October 2026) from the RBI's projection (7.1%).

execution.finalAnswer: India's Finance Ministry has decided to refrain from issuing independent GDP growth and inflation projections for fiscal year 2026-27, choosing instead to work directly with the Reserve Bank of India's estimates. In contrast, the RBI has updated its growth forecast to 7.1 percent, following a strong 7.8 percent GDP growth print in the June quarter.
